name: Eldora Lyon to Konton no Kakera
original_name: エルドラ リヨンと混沌のかけら
source:
Lyon, son of Lord Gilbert, is in love with Marco. But he faces a catastrophic crisis under delusion set by a mysterious man. Lyon's adventure to regain his lover Marco begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
吉尔伯特领主之子里昂爱着马可。然而，一个神秘男人设下的妄想让他面临灾难性的危机。里昂踏上了夺回爱人马可的冒险旅程。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
